transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week.  
Just avoid heavy work and anything strenuous for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can keep using any eye drops you used before the operation, including for dry eyes, unless you were told otherwise.  
If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it is mild, sunglasses outside can help.  
But if it is severe, or you have significant pain, especially if the eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you very much!
